title: Protective effects of Ganoderma lucidum spores on estradiol benzoate-induced TEC apoptosis and compromised double-positive thymocyte development

evidence_spans.quote: In this study, a mice model of estradiol benzoate (EB)-induced thymic atrophy was constructed

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This primary mouse study analyzes an induced phenotype explicitly identified as the onset of immune aging, tests a treatment that mitigates it, and reports a current-report multi-omics analysis.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Ganoderma lucidum spores, including sporoderm-removed GLS (RGLS), in mice with estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy
causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Estradiol benzoate-induced condition without GLS/RGLS treatment
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Thymic epithelial-cell apoptosis, thymic damage, and T-cell/thymocyte development including peripheral CD4+ T-cell output
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Improvement/mitigation of estradiol benzoate-induced thymic atrophy and related developmental outcomes with GLS/RGLS versus the EB-induced comparison condition
